INDIA FREELANCER TAX SET-ASIDE · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER · NOTHING UPLOADED

How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

Enter your professional receipts and expenses. You get new-regime income tax with the 87A rebate and cess, a section 44ADA comparison, the advance tax schedule, and the share of every invoice to put away.

Written from the Union Budget 2025 slabs for FY 2025-26 (assessment year 2026-27) without a live lookup; later figures may differ. The Income Tax Department decides. Not tax advice.

What it does, and what it leaves to you

    
    
      
  • Covers: new-regime income tax slabs from 0% to 30%, the section 87A rebate with marginal relief, 4% health and education cess, the section 44ADA presumptive scheme compared with actual expenses, the advance tax schedule, and GST registration and surcharge warnings.
    • 
      
  • Not decided: the old tax regime and its deductions, TDS already deducted by clients, surcharge amounts, capital gains, interest, dividends, rental income, GST amounts, residency, section 44AD businesses, and exactly how much advance tax you owe. The Income Tax Department or your chartered accountant decides these.
    • 
    

  


  

    
Common questions

    
How much of my freelance income should I set aside for tax in India?

    
Often 5% to 20% of receipts, depending on your profit: under the new regime income up to ₹12 lakh is effectively tax free after the section 87A rebate, and rates then rise from 15% to 30%, plus 4% cess. Enter your receipts and expenses here for a number built from the actual slabs.

    
What is section 44ADA presumptive taxation?

    
A scheme for specified professionals such as consultants, engineers, architects, doctors and lawyers with receipts up to ₹50 lakh (₹75 lakh if at least 95% is received digitally). You declare 50% of receipts as profit without keeping expense records. This tool shows the tax both ways.

    
When is advance tax due for freelancers?

    
If your tax for the year is ₹10,000 or more: 15% by 15 June, 45% by 15 September, 75% by 15 December and 100% by 15 March. Presumptive taxpayers under 44ADA can pay everything by 15 March.

    
When must a freelancer register for GST?

    
When aggregate turnover from services exceeds ₹20 lakh in a year (₹10 lakh in most special category states). GST you collect belongs to the government, so keep it out of your set-aside.

    
Is my data uploaded anywhere?

    
No. Everything is calculated in your browser and nothing is sent.

Your answers. This page runs in your browser and sends nothing anywhere; closing the tab discards them, and downloads are files on your own device.

    
Best-effort hosting, no SLA. These tools are free, experimental, and may be slow, broken, moved, or taken offline without notice. We do not promise uptime, backups of anything you type, or that a URL will keep working. Do not use this as a system of record: nothing you enter is saved anywhere.

    
Everything runs in your browser. Your answers are never uploaded; there are no accounts, cookies, or analytics vendors. Anonymous feature events (analysis_run, example_loaded, summary_downloaded) are counted only in local storage on your device, never with any of your data, and are switched off by Do Not Track.
